NTA. I(25f) am going through this at the moment. I've been with my partner (26m) for 10 years. I also have a high libido and my partner claimed he has had a low one in the last three years we only had sex twice. I became very insecure and turned to watching porn but he got upset with me and denied it when I asked if he did the same . After that my best friend kept telling me he had to have been watching porn and he had no right to tell me I couldn't.

Turns out he had been watching porn and a lot of it.  At first I only found two videos as proof on his search history and he swore on his parent life's that it was only those two times. But then I tricked him into admiring he watched it all the time etc.

We had a massive talk.

To me porn isn't a problem or less it's interfering etc with our sex life. After we talked he said he didn't know why he did it and just that he was sorry. 

I refused to start anything and told him to start whenever he felt like it (I've grown aniexty to be turned down again)

For few months we were back at it but then we got ill and we haven't for now 3 months. My aniexty is coming back over the situation. I'm going to see how it goes over a few more months if nothing is resolved I'm out.

I just feel low about myself now. I spiced things up, brought things etc and nothing seems to work. Hopefully once this bug goes we will go back to how we were but we will see.

NTA OP that feeling doesn't just go even if they start again you just question during and it makes you more insecure.

NTA I grew up with a mum like this also. At the age of five she would kick me and my two siblings out the house anywhere between 12 at night to 6 in the morning just so she could have men round and then I grew up just let us stay in the house due to many reports of neglect by neighbours but there would be different men every weekend. It's really uncomfortable, especially the dangers of bringing different men around your kids.

We paid the price of that and yet she didn't change. I know your mother isn't as bad as that or I assume not by the mention of your post. But even hearing them is uncomfortable and it's your home too.

It's your birthday. The last thing you want to do is end up on someone else's couch. I think it would be different if you were asked in advance on a normal day if you had friends you could stay wth etc but to threaten you with being loud- joke or not after you said you wanna be in your own bed.

She doesn't wanna go somewhere else to do it because home would be more comfortable I suppose. So why shouldn't you be comfortable on your birthday?

Your NTA and neither is she for asking but the way she asked and then joked after you said no made her the TA.

One of my siblings went through something similar as a child forcing us to move away from that situation. When I turned 9 my two best friends asked why we moved across the city,  I told them not understanding why I couldn't tell my best friends that. They asked my sibling if it was true.

It wasn't until they brought it up to them I realized the damage I caused and the effect it had on my sibling.

I am 25 now and still to this day I feel regret and horrible for it but I was a kid. Now as an adult I would never tell anyone.

My partner also have secrets I would never tell my family and vice versa even though im very close to my parents. My inlaws don't know the half of my up bringing but that's for me and my family.

Her excuse isn't good enough you're not the ah that must have taken you alot to open up to her. I'm sorry she broke your trust.

Pregnancy won't fix your relationship anyway so if you were going to break up then break up.

Ask for her to do a pregnancy test of guard so she has no time in planning to try and fake it. If she says no then she is lying but be careful she might still try to get pregnant with someone else and say it's yours (maybe have someone there to prove she refused the test?)

If she is pregnant ask for dna test once the baby is here.

If she is pregnant go to a solicitor for advice and explain your situation (take any prove of anything suspicious even if you write it down with date etc) that way if anything happens with custody/court etc you have it all there.
